name: Calonge de Segarra (Spain)
description: Red field with the yellow monstrance with a white host of the arms, set towards the hoist.
history: The flag was approved on 26 January 2006 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 4574 of 16 February 2006; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, red, with the yellow monstrance and white host of the arms, 9/11 of the height, centred at 7/22 from the hoist edge.

features.role: monstrance with a white host, 9/11 of the height, centred at 7/22 from the hoist
